name: How to Password-Protect a PDF
description: Add RC4-128 encryption to a PDF — processed in your browser, never uploaded.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Set a password and permissions
step.text: Enter the password you want to use. Optionally restrict printing, copying or editing.

step.name: Download the protected PDF
step.text: Click 'Protect PDF'. Your encrypted file downloads immediately — the password is never sent anywhere.
